plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Construction Safety AAS award plan page (blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/construction-safety-aas.html), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. Semester sequence and credit hours transcribed exactly: 15/18/15/12 = 60 credits. The paired 'or'-linked XXXX rows in semesters 3 and 4 are single 3-credit core slots (not two courses) — the only reading under which those semesters sum to their declared totals. The award plan is a suggested sequence. No courses invented.
